svg.title: Kanayama Station — Highway Bus Stops
svg.desc: North-up English schematic showing four highway and overnight bus stops around Kanayama Station: WILLER north, Otsu-dori, VIP Liner north, and Kanayama Station South Exit. Walking routes, coin lockers and an accessible public toilet are included.

g.text: Four highway / overnight bus stops • walking routes • lockers • accessible toilet
North up • stop positions follow the map embedded in the referenced guide
Allow extra time and confirm your ticket.
North Exit → right → cross signal → left
East side of the north area
North Exit → right → cross → right → left
West side of the north area
North Exit → west plaza → left → straight
About 10 m past the city-bus stop
South Exit → straight across plaza → right
Stop names may differ on tickets.
Confirm operator, destination and departure point.
Services change; use the current ticket information.
Locker N1: central passage • N2: behind Tully’s / large lockers • S1: passage between the escalator and Meitetsu Central Gate.
North up • Schematic / not to scale • Stop locations follow the guide’s public map • Routes and destinations must be confirmed on the current ticket.
Source: BusTrip / Bus Hikaku guide updated 10 Jul 2026; official city and railway maps used only for station-access context.
